newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-DORTMUND TRAINER DELIGHTED WITH FIRST HALF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DORTMUND TRAINER DELIGHTED WITH FIRST HALF.

text.p: Borussia Dortmund trainer Ottmar Hitzfeld said on Sunday he was impressed with his injury-depleted team for finishing the first half of the Bundesliga season second to Bayern Munich.
Hitzfeld told the newspaper Bild am Sonntag the reserve players had done a tremendous job, with several key players such as Matthias Sammer sidelined with injuries.

"If we can get second place with the second string players then we must be capable of winning the championship once we are back at full strength again," Hitzfeld said. "Anything less than that would be an embarassment."

Hitzfeld, who expects injured players Steffen Freund and Paulo Sousa back when training for the second half of the season begins on January 13, said the reserves deserved credit for the strong first half.
"They played sensational," Hitzfeld said of the reserves. "We have some truly magnificent players."
